title: fix(ui): new session briefly flashes a temporary row under the agent in Show all sidebar
body:
Related: #174888

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a temporary session row flashes under the agent's row in the Control UI sidebar when you create a new session while the sidebar is in **Show all** agents mode.

Reported by @Patrick-Erichsen.

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/da1d5329-2ac9-481a-bd77-b439a24555de)

## User Impact

User impact: creating a session from the **Show all** agent roster no longer flashes a row that disappears a moment later. The session list (chip) view still shows its provisional row, because that is where the new session actually lands.

## Why This Change Was Made

#174888 placed the pending new-session row in its "sidebar destination". The roster, though, became agent-only and never lists sessions, so that row was rendered under the agent (and below the pinned gallery) for one `sessions.create` round-trip and then dropped once the session was admitted. This change takes the provisional row out of the roster and pinned paths and keeps it only in the session list. The renderer no longer needs the agent filter.

## Evidence

Mock-Gateway recording with `sessions.create` delayed 600 ms, in **Show all** mode. A rAF probe logged every `.sidebar-recent-session--creating` row.

**Before.** A 32px provisional row appears under Harbor (logged inside `sidebar-agent-roster__group` from t=10476 to t=11199 ms) and then vanishes:

![Before: provisional row flashes under the Harbor agent row](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6daebf3d-0516-4f63-8006-5885665aa9e6)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a2f783b-6716-4ef8-b61a-1fedb36a121c

**After.** At the same moment of the create there is no row under Harbor, and the probe log is empty:

![After: no provisional row under Harbor while the session is created](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62b52622-d80a-4375-8c8c-8e70cf4ccda6)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e98b521f-fcdb-441c-83ff-d675866f5478

Tests and checks:

- `ui/src/components/app-sidebar.pinned-agents.test.ts`: new main/recent-agent roster cases fail on `main` (2 failed) and pass with the fix. `pnpm test ui/src/components/app-sidebar.pinned-agents.test.ts ui/src/components/app-sidebar.projection-memo.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` gives 20/20 in about 6s.
- `ui/src/e2e/new-session-pending-sidebar.e2e.test.ts` (mock Gateway, real browser) passes 5/5. Chip mode still shows and restores the provisional row; roster and pinned-agent modes show none.
- `pnpm check:changed` passes typecheck (UI and core tests), lint, format, the i18n check and the controller guard. The `untrack` baseline shrank by one.
- Three `check:changed` failures come from files this PR does not touch:
  - the max-lines ratchet (`chat-message.test.tsx`, `config-page-state.ts`, `sessions-page-state.ts`)
  - the core tsgo shard root budget (`gateway-root` / `plugins-platform` over 720)
  - knip `VideoGenerationProviderOptionType`
- Autoreview (Codex, P0–P2): clean.
